sub_agendas_items.title: 2025 Environmental Excellence Awards
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Chair Menard and City Manager Wendy Stephanson welcomed nominees, the Senior Leadership Team and extended leadership team, who were present to recognize their staff’s efforts, to the 2025 Environmental Excellence Awards.  
The Chair read the list of nominees for the Internal Initiatives category and announced the winner: Neil Grandy for his work on Green Fleet Strategy. 
The Chair then read the list of nominees for the Community category and announced the winners; Brian Ducey, Martin Habicht, Ryan Larose, Paul Mantil, Shawn Norman, Christopher Paquette and Kerry Vernick for their work on Salt Controllers on Sidewalk Machines.
Award recipients received individual award certificates.  All nominees received Certificates of Nomination following the presentation.On behalf of City Council, the City Manager and the Senior Leadership Team, Chair Menard expressed appreciation for the nominees’ work.

sub_agendas_items.title: Tree Protection By-Law – Amendments – Tree Removals

motions.motion_text:
WHEREAS the Tree Protection By-law (No. 2020-340), came into effect on January 1, 2021; and
WHEREAS it is critical that the City of Ottawa assist private property owners in protecting their homes from property damage caused by trees on municipal property; and
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Tree Protection By-law (No. 2020-340) be amended to allow any property owner to remove branches, trim or alter any tree or to remove a tree, trunk, or roots of any tree on their private property; and
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED THAT the General Manager shall approve the removal from municipal property by the City, of any tree, at its cost, upon the request of any adjacent private property owner, where an arborist or engineer states in a letter that the tree is causing or has the potential to cause damage to the private property.

sub_agendas_items.title: Ward 24 Barrhaven East – Gospel Oak Fairlop Neighbourhood – Tree Protection By-Law – Removal of Municipal Trees

motions.motion_text:
WHEREAS the Tree Protection By-law (No. 2020-340), came into effect on January 1, 2021; and
WHEREAS Section 17 (4) provides that “The General Manager may approve the removal from municipal property by the City of, […] (4) a tree that is causing, or likely to cause in the future, serious damage to private property where other mitigation measures are unlikely to prevent future damage; and
WHEREAS it is critical that the City of Ottawa assist private property owners in protecting their homes from property damage caused by trees on municipal property; and
WHEREAS six properties throughout the Gospel Oak Fairlop neighbourhood potentially have issues with adjacent trees on municipal property; and
WHEREAS three properties throughout the Gospel Oak Fairlop neighbourhood have geotechnical reports proving serious property damage caused by adjacent trees on municipal property; and
WHEREAS these reports are evident of a larger problem within this neighbourhood; and
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the General Manager approve the removal from municipal property by the City, at the City’s expense, of any municipal tree in the neighbourhood of Gospel Oak Fairlop, at the request of any adjacent property owner, received between now and December 31, 2026.
motions.post_motion_text: Note:     The notice of motion was subsequently withdrawn by the mover prior to the issu-ance of the agenda for the next meeting (21 April 2026).

sub_agendas_items.title: Municipal Liability Exposure – Pre-construction Activities on the Kanata Lakes Golf Course lands
sub_agendas_items.description:
Submitted by Councillor C. Curry
Ground-disturbance and pre-construction activities are scheduled to commence today on lands comprising approximately 175 acres of documented mercury-impacted soil and water at the Kanata Lakes Golf Course.
My previous inquiry addressed environmental risk assessment, independence, and precaution. This inquiry is distinct and focuses specifically on municipal liability exposure arising from these activities.
Subject: Municipal Liability Exposure – Pre-Construction and Soil Disturbance Activities on the Kanata Lakes Golf Course lands
